creators.name: Lena Vogel
creators.bio: Club & festival videographer. 8 years shooting Berlin nightlife: Berghain side rooms to open-air festivals. I deliver a 60-second recap edit within 48h and full set coverage within a week.

reviews.reviewerAvatarUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 64 64"><rect width="64" height="64" rx="14" fill="%231f2937"/><circle cx="32" cy="22" r="9" fill="%2393c5fd" opacity="0.4"/><text x="32" y="44" font-family="Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle" fill="%2393c5fd">DN</text></svg>
reviews.body: Lena was incredible. Showed up early, scouted the booth angles before doors, and the recap edit was in my inbox before I’d even flown home.
Understands club lighting like nobody else. Zero flash, zero crowd disruption, footage looks like a movie.
Great footage and fast delivery. Vertical crops needed one revision round, turned around same-day.

creators.name: Marco Reyes
creators.bio: Music photographer based in Barcelona. Resident shooter for two clubs in Poble-sec, regular at Sónar week events. I shoot press-kit quality stills. The kind agencies actually use.

reviews.body: My booking agency replaced my entire press kit with Marco’s shots. That says everything.
Fast, invisible during the set, and the edit selection he sent was already curated.

creators.name: Amara Okafor
creators.bio: Licensed drone operator (EU A2 cert) + ground videographer. Festival aftermovies are my specialty: aerial establishing shots cut with ground-level energy. Fully insured.

reviews.body: The aerial open of her aftermovie got us 2M views. Worth every cent, and she handled all the flight permits herself.

creators.name: Tom Hartley
creators.bio: London-based videographer covering club nights, label parties and intimate venue sessions. Fast turnaround on social-first edits: vertical cuts delivered within 24 hours.

reviews.body: 24h turnaround as promised. The vertical edit performed better than anything my own team has cut.
Solid footage, good vibe. Communication before the gig was a bit slow but on the night he was flawless.

creators.name: Yuki Tanaka
creators.bio: Analog + digital hybrid photographer. I shoot a roll of 35mm film alongside digital at every gig. Artists love the film scans for album art and posters.

reviews.body: The film scans became my next EP cover. Yuki has an eye you cannot teach.

creators.name: Priya Sharma
creators.bio: NYC nightlife videographer. Brooklyn warehouse scene regular. Multi-cam coverage with a second shooter available for bigger productions.

reviews.body: Multi-cam coverage made my livestream look like a Cercle set. Priya runs the whole thing solo.

creators.name: Dries Vermeulen
creators.bio: Newer to the network but shooting events for 3 years. Affordable rates while I build my Gigshot reputation. Same gear, hungrier edits.

reviews.body: Great value for the rate. Footage was strong; delivery took a few days longer than quoted.

creators.name: Sofia Lindqvist
creators.bio: Social-first content specialist. I don’t just film your set. I run your stories live during the gig, capture fan content, and hand you a 7-day posting plan with edited assets.

reviews.body: Gained 4k followers the week after working with Sofia. She thinks like a manager, not just a camera.
The 7-day posting plan alone is worth the rate. Everything pre-captioned, pre-cut, scheduled.

creators.name: Nova Kaine
creators.avatarUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 64 64"><rect width="64" height="64" rx="14" fill="%231f3320"/><circle cx="32" cy="22" r="9" fill="%23a3e635" opacity="0.4"/><text x="32" y="44" font-family="Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle" fill="%23a3e635">NK</text></svg>
creators.bio: Open-format club & festival DJ. Berlin-based, touring Europe most weekends. Warm-up to peak-time: I read the room and build the night. Book me for club nights, brand parties and private events.

reviews.body: Booked Nova to warm up before my live set. Read the energy perfectly and handed me a packed floor. Pro from soundcheck to last track.

creators.name: Mara Jansen
creators.bio: Hard groove DJ from Hamburg. Warm-ups and closings for touring headliners, vinyl-leaning sets. Currently splitting weekends between Hamburg and Berlin.

windows.note: Club weekend run, one slot open

reviews.body: Warmed the room exactly right before our b2b. Zero ego, all groove.
Great selection and easy to coordinate with. Set ran a touch over but the floor loved it.

creators.name: Jonas Petersen
creators.bio: Club videographer in Köln, fresh on Gigshot. Three years of venue work off-platform; verified and ready for the first booking here.
creators.turnaround: 60-second recap within 48h, full edit within a week

creators.name: Alex Nowak

creators.name: Leo Grech
creators.bio: Malta-based techno DJ. Island residencies in winter, touring the continent in summer. Peak-time and open-to-close formats.
creators.credits: Resident nights in Paceville; festival closings across Malta and Sicily

reviews.body: Shared a bill on the island. Leo closed after me and somehow lifted the floor AGAIN. Total pro.

creators.name: Zofia Krawczyk
creators.bio: Warsaw club content specialist. I shoot vertical-first during the set and hand over a ready-to-post pack the next morning.
creators.deliverableFormats: 9:16 verticals, 10–15 edited stills per set, RAWs on request

reviews.body: The posting pack was scheduled before I woke up. Warsaw content sorted, forever.
Fast, invisible on the floor, strong edits. One revision round on the color grade.

creators.name: Nico Fontaine
creators.bio: Tour videographer, on the road most of the year — no fixed base, my travel windows say where I am. Between shows I take club and label bookings.

windows.note: On tour with a live act — free between shows

reviews.body: Travelled four dates with us. The nightly recaps kept our socials alive the whole leg.

creators.name: Ruth Okonjo-Beck
creators.bio: VJ and visuals artist. LED walls, live-reactive sets, projection mapping for club rooms. I make the room move with the music.
creators.credits: Toured visuals for two live techno acts; club residencies in Friedrichshain

reviews.body: Her visuals reacted to every hardware move on stage. The A/V set people still ask about.

creators.name: Sander Vos
creators.bio: Amsterdam DJ, fifteen years behind decks. Melodic to driving, warehouse to festival stage. I bring my own light tech contact if you need one.

reviews.body: Golden-hour set that made the whole boat film at once. Booked him again before we docked.

creators.name: Ines Almeida
creators.bio: Lisbon music photographer. Open-air stages, hillside sunsets, basement clubs — film and digital side by side.

reviews.body: The golden-hour stills became my new press kit. She sees light nobody else does.

creators.name: Felix Brandt
creators.bio: Licensed drone pilot (EU A2) and ground shooter out of Munich. Alpine open-airs are the home turf; insured, permits handled.

windows.note: Festival aerial gig — extra days open

reviews.body: The drone reveal over the ridge opened our aftermovie. Permits, insurance, all handled without asking.

creators.name: Marek Svoboda
creators.bio: Prague videographer, first season on Gigshot. Fast vertical edits at friendly rates while I build my reviews here.

reviews.body: First booking through the platform for both of us in Prague. Vertical edit landed before my flight home.

creators.name: Nino Beridze
creators.bio: Tbilisi DJ. Dark, driving sets built for long rooms. Available across the Caucasus and for European club weekends.
creators.credits: Club resident in Tbilisi; toured Georgia and Armenia

reviews.body: Handed me a floor already locked in. Tbilisi crowds are lucky to have her.

creators.name: Hana Vogler
creators.bio: Vienna music photographer. Press kits agencies actually use, festival pits, basement clubs. Bilingual DE/EN production notes.

reviews.body: Our Vienna date finally has photos our agency did not have to retouch. Booked for the next run.

creators.name: Timo Wagner
creators.bio: Stage manager and production crew, Berlin. Load-in to load-out, stage plots, show calling — new to Gigshot now that crew can hold a first-class profile here.

artists.name: DJ Nova
artists.avatarUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 64 64"><rect width="64" height="64" rx="14" fill="%231f2937"/><circle cx="32" cy="22" r="9" fill="%2393c5fd" opacity="0.4"/><text x="32" y="44" font-family="Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle" fill="%2393c5fd">DN</text></svg>
artists.bio: Melodic techno DJ touring across Europe. I book a local creator in every city I play: consistent content, zero logistics. My entire press kit and socials run on Gigshot creators.

reviews.body: Dream client. Clear brief, guest-list sorted before I asked, paid the same night. Artists like Nova are why I’m on this platform.
Responsive, trusted my creative calls, credited me on every post. Would shoot for Nova anytime.
Smooth booking, brief was detailed, venue access pre-arranged. Five stars.

artists.name: KARLA B2B SET
artists.bio: Hard groove duo. We tour as a pair and need creators who can handle fast-moving b2b energy in dark rooms.

reviews.body: Professional duo, clear about what they wanted, flexible on the night. Great to work with.
Good gig, fair pay. Brief arrived a bit last-minute but they were great in person.

artists.name: Moodtrap
artists.bio: Live deep house act. Hardware on stage, visuals matter. I invest heavily in content. It’s how a live act survives.

reviews.body: Knows exactly what a live act needs on camera. Briefed me on every hardware moment to catch. A creator’s dream artist.
Flew me a brief two weeks ahead with timestamps of the set structure. Unreal preparation.

artists.name: Selva
artists.bio: Organic house selector. Sunset slots, boat parties, anything golden hour. Building my visual identity gig by gig.

reviews.body: Lovely to work with, strong aesthetic vision, fast payment. Recommended.
Gave me a real shot while I’m still building reviews here. Generous with feedback and credit.

artists.name: Nachtfalter
artists.bio: Industrial techno live act. Two machines, one strobe, no laptop. Berlin basements and festival dark stages.

artists.name: Orbit Artists
artists.bio: Boutique booking agency for touring electronic acts. We book one local creator per stop for every artist on the roster.
